content: नक्षत्रम् [न क्षरति; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 3. 105</ls> also] .²1 A star in general. .²2 A constellation, an asterism in the moonʼs path, lunar mansion; नक्षत्राणामहं शशी <ls>Bg. 10. 21</ls>. नक्षत्रताराग्रहसंकुलापि <ls>R. 6. 22</ls>; (they are twenty-seven). .²3 A pearl. .²4 A necklace of 27 pearls.
